xBRIEFInfo.description: Plan for PAN-4654: Fleet versions and Update all, including harness CLIs

plan.title: Fleet versions and Update all, including harness CLIs
plan.author: agent:claude-opus-5-5

narratives.Problem: Linked machines (PAN-4645) show state and Overdeck version per link, but nothing shows the harness CLI versions across machines, the unsupported state's refusal path names the wrong version to install when the peer is older, and there is no way to update Overdeck and the harness CLIs on every machine at once without interrupting running turns.
narratives.Proposal: Each machine serves a version report (GET /api/versions/self: Overdeck version, install mode, link protocol, each installed harness CLI with version and update plan from new HarnessCapabilities fields) and runs its own persisted update job (when-idle waits for zero working turns machine-wide, harness CLIs first via npm or their own update verb, Overdeck last via UpdateManager plus a gate-claiming restart, before/after recorded). The viewing machine aggregates a fleet table (GET /api/machines/versions) and fans Update all out over links (POST /api/machines/update), fenced to operator-level links with an operator actor. Unsupported links name the exact version and npm command. Surfaces: pan machines versions|update, a Fleet versions panel in Settings → Anywhere, docs, and a two-machine smoke run with fake CLIs.
narratives.NonGoals:
- Updating machines that are offline, connecting, unsupported or revoked (they are listed and skipped)
- Choosing a target version for Overdeck or any harness CLI; the request body carries only mode
- Updating OhMyPi (omp), Muse or Prime Agent, or installing a missing harness CLI
- Updating Overdeck on development or desktop installs, or running pan reload from the job
- Restarting or resuming running agents or conversations after a harness update
- Changing ENVIRONMENT_PROTOCOL_VERSION, LINK_PROTOCOL_VERSION, the descriptor, the heartbeat or MachineLinkView
- Per-harness turn waiting, scheduled or automatic fleet updates
- Running any real harness or Overdeck update on the operator's machine during implementation or tests
- Fleet usage (FR-31), settings comparison (FR-32) and every other PAN-2350 work item

metadata.sizeJustification: W-LINK7 is a single work item the PAN-2350 epic assigned to this issue; its done-when (unsupported shows the exact version; Update all on two machines changes claude and codex on both and waits for turns) needs the per-machine report, the update job, the fenced routes, the fleet aggregation, CLI, panel and docs together. The surface spans contracts, lib, server, CLI, frontend, scripts and docs because it is one vertical feature; each item is still small and independently reviewable.

autoDecisions.summary: Protocol gating keeps the PAN-4645 link-protocol gate; fix the refusal-path version bug and append the exact npm install command; never bump ENVIRONMENT_PROTOCOL_VERSION.
autoDecisions.rationale: The done-when asks for the exact version to install; the refusal path names the older peer's own version today, and bumping the environment protocol breaks desktop clients (D-4645-11).

autoDecisions.summary: Turn wait is machine-wide: zero 'working' entries in the live agent directory, re-checked every 5 s, never auto-proceeding; Update now and Cancel are the exits.
autoDecisions.rationale: FR-29 says 'a machine with a turn in progress'; the Overdeck npm install replaces files running agents' pan calls read, so a per-harness wait would not protect it.

autoDecisions.summary: Updated harness CLIs: claude, codex, kimi (kimi-code/acp), opencode. muse (no update verb), prime-agent (pinned 0.8) and ohmypi (support being removed) are listed but not updated.
autoDecisions.rationale: Probed --help on this machine; the three excluded ones either lack an update command, would break a pinned compat range, or are being removed.

autoDecisions.summary: Update target is always latest on the machine's own channel; the request body carries only mode.
autoDecisions.rationale: Update all means update; letting a remote caller choose versions or commands would allow downgrades and arbitrary exec.

autoDecisions.summary: Development and desktop installs skip the Overdeck component with a reason and still update harness CLIs.
autoDecisions.rationale: UpdateManager already refuses development builds (this machine reports installMode development); the desktop app has its own updater.

autoDecisions.summary: Each machine runs and persists its own job in ${OVERDECK_HOME}/fleet-update.json; the viewing machine stores no fleet state and reads jobs from each machine's report.
autoDecisions.rationale: Store no status you can derive; the persisted job is needed only to carry before/after across the Overdeck restart.

autoDecisions.summary: Update and cancel are allowed through a link only for an operator-level link with an operator actor stamp; machine tokens keep their scopes (operate row plus a handler check), no new scope.
autoDecisions.rationale: Mirrors the FR-4 fence; a new scope would not reach already-issued machine tokens.

autoDecisions.summary: Older peers without the feature are detected by a 404 from GET /api/versions/self rather than a new descriptor capability flag.
autoDecisions.rationale: Equivalent signal with no protocol or descriptor change (NFR-5).

autoDecisions.summary: No sibling split; one issue with plan.metadata.sizeJustification.
autoDecisions.rationale: The epic scoped W-LINK7 to this issue and its done-when needs the report, job and table together.

narrative.Action: PRD WI-5 and D-3, D-4, D-5, D-8, D-13. Export getUpdateManager from misc/updates.ts (rename of private getManager). Create FleetUpdateService with the injectable FleetUpdateDeps of the PRD and a module singleton fleetUpdateService(): current(), start(mode, requestedBy), escalate(), cancel(), run(), boot(). Job persisted atomically (temp + rename) at ${OVERDECK_HOME}/fleet-update.json on every phase change. when-idle waits for zero working entries from getLiveAgentDirectory() re-checking every 5 s and never proceeds on its own; harness CLIs first (one failure never stops the next), Overdeck last via UpdateManager check/install with a 1 s snapshot poll (10 min cap); restart via restartDashboardDetached('fleet-update:<id>') only when Overdeck installed; development/desktop -> Overdeck skipped with the PRD reason. boot() finishes a 'restarting' job (after = running version) and fails an interrupted waiting/updating job. Commands run with stdin ignored, 10-minute timeout, output tail 2,000 chars. main.ts calls boot() beside startAnywhere when hostsMachineLinks() (src/lib/boot-gates.ts) is true. Tests use vi.useFakeTimers and an in-memory file map; never real exec.
